Diagnostic preview (what the tool actually sees)

Capture is BLACK. The game is probably using FLAG_SECURE, so the tool cannot see the table. There is no legitimate bypass.
Shows while the guideline tool is capturing the screen.
The tool needs “Display over other apps” to draw aim lines. Please enable it, then come back.

This is a companion helper, not a mod. It does not touch the game, its files, or its memory, and it never plays for you.

But be honest with yourself: an overlay that draws aim lines over a game gives you an in-game advantage. The game can detect the overlay (every touch on a line is reported as obscured), and it can hide the table from screen capture entirely with FLAG_SECURE. No tool can promise you will not be banned.

Use a secondary or guest account first. If the capture preview shows a black frame, the game is secure and this tool cannot help with it.
Drag the four red handles to the table corners, then Save. Re-detect runs the automatic table finder on the current frame.
Calibration cleared — auto-detect will be used.
Table not found in this frame. Drag the handles by hand.
Table found — check the corners, then Save.
